description: Runs a signal monitor once now, whatever its status (paused or on; not archived), and leaves that status as it is: a paused signal stays paused and does not run daily, and a later pause does not stop this run. The first call (confirmed false or absent) runs nothing and returns the most this run can cost (maxCredits); the call with confirmed true runs it. Only what it delivers is charged.

confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to the quoted maxCredits.
